description: This file defines the UI components and logic for the 'Topic' screen in an Android app using Jetpack Compose. It includes composable functions for displaying topic details, a list of news resources, and UI elements like toolbar and header, with state management and previews.

classes.name: TopicScreen
classes.description: Main composable function for displaying the topic details and news list, managing state and UI layout.

classes.name: TopicUiState
classes.description: Sealed class representing the loading, error, or success state of the topic data.

classes.name: NewsUiState
classes.description: Sealed class representing the loading, error, or success state of news resources.

classes.name: FollowableTopic
classes.description: Data class representing a topic that can be followed or unfollowed.

methods.name: TopicScreen
methods.description: Composable that observes ViewModel state and sets up the topic screen with event tracking.

methods.name: TopicScreen (internal)
methods.description: Internal composable that renders the UI based on current state, including toolbar, header, news list, and scrollbar.

methods.name: topicItemsSize
methods.description: Calculates the number of items in the list based on UI state for scrollbar purposes.

methods.name: topicBody
methods.description: Builds the main content of the topic, including header and news resource cards.

methods.name: TopicHeader
methods.description: Displays the topic image, name, and description.

methods.name: userNewsResourceCards
methods.description: Displays news resource cards or loading/error placeholders based on state.

methods.name: TopicToolbar
methods.description: Displays back button and follow/unfollow toggle for the topic.

methods.name: TopicScreenPopulated
methods.description: Preview composable with sample data for a populated topic screen.

methods.name: TopicScreenLoading
methods.description: Preview composable showing loading state of the topic screen.
